source.title: Counterfactual choice and learning in a neural network centered on human lateral frontopolar cortex.

confidence_rationale: Directly supports the LICITNESS half of the chip scope: a dedicated network tracks the best counterfactual option and carries a counterfactual prediction error for learning from hypothetical feedback, with individual variation predicting the ability to learn from it. Retaining-and-using unchosen options is a normal adaptive function. Confidence discounted because the signal is forward/next-decision, not the retrospective responsibility use MECH-487 leg 3 targets, and the authors explicitly separate it from regret theory.
failure_signatures: The network encodes the BEST counterfactual option, not an undifferentiated set; a retention mechanism that hoards all rejected candidates indiscriminately diverges from the biology and inflates the confabulation surface.

Counterfactual prediction errors here 'cannot be related to regret theory' -- i.e. this is forward value-learning, not retrospective self-attribution; using it as evidence for the responsibility-attribution use of retention is a transfer that must be flagged, not assumed.

mapping.source_claim_statement: In a three-alternative task, a network centred on lateral frontopolar cortex (with dorsomedial frontal and posteromedial cortex) encodes the reward evidence favouring the BEST counterfactual option at future decisions and carries a counterfactual prediction error for learning from hypothetical feedback; individual variation predicts propensity to switch to profitable choices and ability to learn from hypothetical feedback. These counterfactual prediction errors cannot be related to regret theory.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports the licitness half of the chip's question: retaining and learning from rejected/unchosen options is a normal, dedicated, adaptive brain function, not an exotic add-on -- so admitting MECH-487 retained candidates into later evaluation is biologically warranted, provided (per the MECH-322/Janner bounding) it stays a prior for future testing rather than a self-validating loop. It also bears on Q-090's admission criterion: the brain retains the BEST counterfactual option, i.e. retention is selective, favouring a same-scale-with-selectivity reading over hoarding all candidates.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The signal is prospective/next-decision value-learning, not the retrospective responsibility-attribution use MECH-487 leg 3 needs, and the authors explicitly divorce it from regret. Its support is for licitness-of-retain-and-learn and for selectivity of admission, not for the specific self-attribution mechanism.
mapping.source_context: Healthy adults; fMRI; three-alternative decision task with hypothetical feedback; lateral frontopolar / dorsomedial frontal / posteromedial cortex.

confidence_components.notes: Strong PLoS Biology result establishing a counterfactual-learning system. Mapping strong for licitness + selectivity; the retrospective-responsibility transfer is explicitly not licensed by the paper and is flagged, not claimed.
